{"version": 1, "content": "

SETUP: MODELS, LORAS & CUSTOM NODES

Qwen Image 2.1 head swap and body swap with the BFS LoRAs. Install everything below, restart ComfyUI, then reload this workflow. Needs a ComfyUI build with native Qwen Image 2.1 support (0.37 or newer, tested on 0.38.2). Model download is about 31 GB.

 Model Links

Hugging Face repos: Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 · Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap

diffusion_models

  • qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors (14.2 GB) - Load Diffusion Model.

text_encoders

  • qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors (about 16 GB) - Load CLIP.

vae

  • qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors (676 MB) - Load VAE.

loras

  • bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors - Head Swap LoRA, strength 1.0.
  • bfs_body_swap_v1.0_qwen_2.1.safetensors (210 MB) - Body Swap LoRA, strength 1.0.

 Model Storage Location

📂 ComfyUI/
└── 📂 models/
    ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
    │   └── qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors
    ├── 📂 text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors
    ├── 📂 vae/
    │   └── qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors
    └── 📂 loras/
        ├── bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors
        └── bfs_body_swap_v1.0_qwen_2.1.safetensors

Terminal shortcut (run inside ComfyUI/models):

  • hf download Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 diffusion_models/qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_bf16.safetensors vae/qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors --local-dir .
  • hf download Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap bfs_head_v1.1_qwen_2.1.safetensors bfs_body_swap_v1.0_qwen_2.1.safetensors --local-dir loras

 Custom nodes to install

Easiest: ComfyUI Manager → Install Custom Nodes → search the name → Install → Restart. Or open this workflow and press Install Missing Custom Nodes. Custom nodes live in ComfyUI/custom_nodes/.

  • rgthree-comfy - Any Switch and the Model Swap group toggle. github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy
  • ComfyUI-KJNodes - Resize Image v2, Image Concat, Add Label, Set/Get nodes. github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes
  • RES4LYF - extra samplers. The KSampler uses sampler deis_2m, which comes from this pack. github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF (needs pip install -r RES4LYF/requirements.txt, or install it from Manager)
  • ComfyUI-Pixaroma - Load Image Mini (Scene Reference, New Image Replace), Pick Orientation and Size, Prompt, Compare, Run Timer and this note. Search Pixaroma in Manager, or git clone https://gitlab.com/pixaroma/comfyui-pixaroma.git

Terminal shortcut (run inside ComfyUI/custom_nodes):

  • git clone https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF
  • pip install -r RES4LYF/requirements.txt

Everything else (Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1, Qwen Image 2.1 Cache, KSampler, Save Image and so on) is built into ComfyUI. If one of those is red, update ComfyUI.

 Quick check before you run

  • Scene Reference is <image1> (the photo whose pose, lighting and background are kept). New Image Replace is <image2> (the head or person to put in). Do not swap them.
  • In the Model Swap toggle keep exactly one group on: Head Swap or Body Swap. The off group is muted, so its LoRA and prompt are skipped.
  • Both LoRA dropdowns list their file, and sampler_name deis_2m is available in the KSampler.
  • Body Swap works best when the reference is a full-body, standing, front-facing person on a plain light background. A tight portrait or a busy background weakens the result.
  • If the output is just the original photo, check the Final prompt label under the result and make sure the right group is on, then try another seed.
  • The reference image is scaled to about 0.59 MP on purpose (the Body Swap guide found this keeps the scene's background and lighting best). If faces get soft, raise megapixels in Reference → 0.59 MP toward 1.0.

Responsible use: do not use or share results of public figures or of people who have not given consent.

promptState.text: Change the pose to a full-body shot: the same person stands facing the camera directly, front view, body and shoulders squared to the camera, looking straight into the lens with a soft, calm expression. Arms relaxed naturally at her sides, weight evenly on both feet, standing upright. Show her entire body from head to toe with some space above the head and below the feet. Keep her face, identity, hair, exactly the same clothes. Same bright white studio wall with soft diagonal window-light shadows, same natural soft lighting and color tone. Photorealistic, sharp focus, high detail.

nodes.title: Enhance Detail: how it works
widgets_values:
Turn on with the '✨ Enhance Detail (on/off)' switch.

Qwen Image 2.1 redraws the result in ~2 MP tiles, using each tile as a reference.
Restore 0.5 keeps it close, Detailer 0.75 adds fine detail, Viggle Turbo = 8 steps.
Text encoder and VAE are shared with the main workflow.

Megapixels: size of the enhanced image. About 1.6-2x per side works best.
More detail: Restore off, Detailer 1.0. Closer to the picture: Restore 0.75, Detailer 0.5.
Viggle Turbo = Qwen Research License (research use).

nodes.title: Turbo model (int8 แนะนำ · เลือก turbo_bf16 ได้)
⚡ Turbo (true = Turbo 8 steps · false = bf16 25 steps)
Note: Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)
widgets_values:
## Speed settings (ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel)

- **⚡ Turbo (true)** in Sampling: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo int8, 8 steps with the turbo sigmas, CFG 1 (what Paiton's
  Qwen-Image server runs). false = the original KSampler path (bf16 model, 25 steps, the sampler/steps switches,
  LoRAs from the Power Lora Loader / swap groups). The turbo branch does **not** use those LoRAs, so keep Turbo off
  for Head Switch / Body Switch.
- **Text Encoder BF16** after Load CLIP: the Qwen3-VL 8B encoder (and its vision tower) in bf16. Same picture
  (44 dB vs fp32), encode 42 s → 2.3 s.

Measured on the R9700 (220 W), Normal Edit, one 2720x1536 reference, 1920x1088 output:
| | prompt change | same prompt, new seed |
|---|---|---|
| Original (bf16, 25 steps, fp32 encoder) | ~110 s | 69.8 s |
| **This workflow (turbo + bf16 encoder)** | **19.0 s** | **16.6 s** |
Paiton reference: 8.4 s at 1024x1024 with one reference.

Turbo follows the edit prompt like the base model, with small differences (e.g. dress length) from the base result.

Note for this copy: the measured times above used a "Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1 (CFG 1)" node that skips the negative encode (not part of ComfyUI-RDNA4-Accel). This copy uses the core Text Encode Qwen Image 2.1, so the text encode with reference images takes about twice as long. The picture is the same at CFG 1.
